# Git proxy: run-scoped grants and the fetch path

## What to build

Add the Rakazo **git smart-HTTP proxy** to the API, plus the per-run **proxy grants** the bot's computer uses to authenticate to it. With this slice a real `git clone` / `git fetch` of a bound repository works through `https://<api>/git/<bindingId>.git`. The proxy:

- checks the grant on every request
- confirms the grant's run is still active and the repository is still bound
- loads the connection's host token from the secret store
- streams the request and response bodies to and from the host's smart-HTTP endpoint

The host token never leaves the server. Pushes (`git-receive-pack`) are refused with a clear git-readable message in this slice; the push policy slice replaces that refusal.

The slice also:
- adds a git smart-HTTP backend to the offline `CodeHostEmulator`, using the system `git http-backend`, so the whole path is tested offline with the real `git` CLI
- deletes grants whenever a run ends

Decision already made: a grant has **no timer**. It is valid only while its run is active (`queued | leased | running | waiting_input | waiting_takeover`). It is deleted when the run completes, fails or is cancelled.

Already in the codebase:
- **Prisma models.**
  - `GitProxyGrant { id, spaceId, userId, tokenHash @unique, runId → Run (cascade), botRepositoryId → BotRepository (cascade), createdAt }`.
  - `BotRepository { id, spaceId, userId, botId, connectionId → CodeHostConnection, hostRepoId, fullPath, defaultBranch, branchPrefix }`.
- **Contract.** `CodeHostProvider` in `packages/adapter-kit/src/code-host.ts` has `gitCredential(conn) → { username, password }` and `remoteUrl(conn, repo)`. The latter returns e.g. `https://gitlab.example.com/acme/docs.git`.
- **Helpers.** `loadCodeHostConnection(prisma, secrets, row)` in `packages/adapters/src/code-host-credentials.ts`.
- **Composition.** `createCodeHostProviders` in `packages/adapters/src/code-host-factory.ts`. `apps/api/src/app.ts` builds `codeHosts` with `createSafeRemoteFetch(..., { allowPrivateEndpoint: env.mcpAllowPrivateEndpoint })` and accepts `CreateAppOverrides.codeHosts`.
- **Emulator.** `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts` has `CodeHostEmulator(flavor)`, a real `node:http` server on 127.0.0.1 with GitLab `/api/v4` and GitHub `/api/v3` REST. It provides `addToken` and `addProject({ fullPath, defaultBranch, tokens })`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `CODE-HOST-INTEGRATION-PRD.md` sections 6, 9 ("Proxy grants", "Push rules" rule 1) and 10 ("Git proxy").
- `apps/api/src/app.ts`:

  - lines 976–1005: raw route mounts. Mount `mountGitProxyRoutes` beside these.
  - lines 236–257: `CreateAppOverrides`.
- `apps/api/src/github-webhook.ts` (lines 169–180): raw Hono route style with early rejection.
- `apps/api/src/account-import.ts` (lines 1004–1050): streaming a request body with a byte cap, and authenticating before reading.
- `apps/api/src/request-body-limit.ts` (lines 49–76): re-wrapping a body with `duplex: "half"`. It only buffers `/rpc/*` and `/api/auth/*`, so `/git/*` bodies stay streams.
- `apps/api/src/account-export.ts` (lines 215–227): streaming a `Response` body.
- `apps/api/src/http-body.ts`: `cancelBody(body)`.
- `apps/api/src/messaging-webhook.test.ts` (lines 7–33): testing a raw route with `new Hono()` and `app.request(...)`.
- `packages/db/src/run-secrets.ts`:
  - lines 20–37: `deleteRunSecretsInTransaction`, called on every run-ending path.
  - lines 44–80: `clearEndedRunState`.
- `packages/core/src/run-state.ts`: `ACTIVE_RUN_STATUSES`, `isActiveRunStatus` (line ~72).
- `packages/adapters/src/credential-digest.ts`: `credentialDigest(value)`, the sha256 hex digest.
- `packages/adapters/src/mcp-emulator.ts`: HTTP server pattern.
- `packages/adapters/src/remote-mcp.ts` (lines 223–260): the safe fetch passes `init` through. It throws `ConnectorRedirectError` on 3xx and `Could not reach <host>` on network errors.

## Patterns to follow

**Grant issuing (used by the checkout tool in a later slice), new file `packages/adapters/src/git-proxy-grants.ts`:**
```ts
export async function issueGitProxyGrant(
  prisma: Pick<PrismaClient, "gitProxyGrant">,
  input: { runId: string; spaceId: string; userId: string; botRepositoryId: string },
): Promise<string> {
  const token = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  await prisma.$transaction?.(...) // or two calls: delete older grants for the same run+binding, then create
  await prisma.gitProxyGrant.deleteMany({ where: { runId: input.runId, botRepositoryId: input.botRepositoryId } });
  await prisma.gitProxyGrant.create({ data: { ...input, tokenHash: credentialDigest(token) } });
  return token; // only ever returned to the caller; never logged or stored in plaintext
}
export function gitProxyRemoteUrl(apiUrl: string, botRepositoryId: string): string {
  return new URL(`/git/${botRepositoryId}.git`, apiUrl).toString();
}
```
**Proxy auth:** HTTP Basic, username `rakazo`, password = the grant.
- No or invalid `Authorization` header: respond `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="rakazo"` and a text/plain body `rakazo: authentication required`.
- A header that doesn't map to a live grant (unknown grant, run ended, binding mismatch, connection removed): respond `403` with `content-type: text/plain` and body `rakazo: this repository access has ended; run code_repo_checkout again\n`. Git prints text/plain error bodies as `remote:` lines.
- Neither response may ever include host names, tokens or internal ids.

**Run scope:** routes run under `runAsSystem("git proxy", ...)` through the prefix list in `app.ts`. Every lookup must still filter by the grant's own `spaceId`/`userId`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/git-proxy-grants.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `issueGitProxyGrant` and `gitProxyRemoteUrl` as above.
  - `resolveGitProxyGrant(prisma, token, bindingId)`. It:
    - looks up `gitProxyGrant.findUnique({ where: { tokenHash: credentialDigest(token) }, include: { run: { select: { id, status, botId, spaceId, userId } }, botRepository: { include: { connection: true } } } })`
    - returns `null` unless all of these hold: `grant.botRepositoryId === bindingId`, `isActiveRunStatus(run.status)`, `botRepository.botId === run.botId`, and `connection` exists
    - otherwise returns `{ grant, run, binding, connection }`
- **GOTCHA**: compare `bindingId` after the lookup by hash (hash lookup is the constant-time part). Export from the adapters barrel.

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/run-secrets.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `deleteRunSecretsInTransaction`, also run `tx.gitProxyGrant.deleteMany({ where: { runId: { in: runs.map((r) => r.id) } } })`. Widen the `tx` param type to `Pick<Prisma.TransactionClient, "secret" | "gitProxyGrant">`, and the `prisma` param of `clearEndedRunState` to include `"gitProxyGrant"`. Then fix every caller's type error (`pnpm check` lists them; they pass full clients, so usually only `Pick<>` declarations need widening). Callers live in `packages/db/src/events.ts` (around 1867), `cancel-runs.ts`, `expire-stuck-run.ts` and `packages/adapters/src/child-bots.ts`.
- **GOTCHA**: fake prisma objects in existing unit tests may lack `gitProxyGrant`. Add a `gitProxyGrant: { deleteMany: async () => ({ count: 0 }) }` stub to each test helper that fails. Don't change test behavior.

### UPDATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** git smart HTTP on the same server:
  - **Setup.** `start()` creates a temp dir (`mkdtemp`). `addProject` also runs `git init --bare -b <defaultBranch> <dir>/<fullPath>.git` and `git -C <bare> config http.receivepack true`. It then seeds one commit by cloning into a temp worktree, committing `README.md`, and pushing, using `execFileSync("git", ...)` with `GIT_AUTHOR_*`/`GIT_COMMITTER_*` env set.
  - **Routing.** Requests whose path ends in `/info/refs`, `/git-upload-pack` or `/git-receive-pack` under `/<fullPath>.git` are git requests:
    - Require Basic auth whose password is a known token that is a member of the project. Otherwise respond 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic`.
    - Spawn `git http-backend` with CGI env `GIT_PROJECT_ROOT=<tmp>`, `GIT_HTTP_EXPORT_ALL=1`, `PATH_INFO=/<fullPath>.git/<rest>`, `REQUEST_METHOD`, `QUERY_STRING`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `CONTENT_LENGTH` (when present), `HTTP_CONTENT_ENCODING`, `HTTP_GIT_PROTOCOL`, `REMOTE_USER=<username>`, `REMOTE_ADDR=127.0.0.1`.
    - Pipe the request body to stdin. Parse the CGI headers from stdout up to the blank line (`Status: 200 OK`, `Content-Type`, ...), write status and headers, then pipe the rest.
  - **Helpers.** `refs(fullPath): Record<string, string>` (via `git for-each-ref`) and `commitSubjects(fullPath, ref)`, for test assertions.
  - **Cleanup.** `stop()` removes the temp dir.
- **GOTCHA**: export `hasGit(): boolean` (tries `git --version`). Git-dependent tests use `describe.skipIf(!hasGit())`. CI runners have git, so they run there.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/git-proxy.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `export function mountGitProxyRoutes(app: Hono, deps: { prisma; secrets: SecretStore; codeHosts: CodeHostProviders })`:
  - **Routes:**
    - `app.get("/git/:repo/info/refs", ...)`
    - `app.post("/git/:repo/git-upload-pack", ...)`
    - `app.post("/git/:repo/git-receive-pack", ...)`
  - **Path parsing.** `:repo` must match `/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64})\.git$/`; otherwise respond 404.
  - **Steps for each request:**
    1. Parse Basic auth. If it is missing, respond 401 (see pattern) and `cancelBody`.
    2. `resolveGitProxyGrant`. If it returns null, respond 403 with the text/plain message.
    3. Resolve the provider: `deps.codeHosts[connection.provider]`. If it is missing, respond 403.
    4. `ref = await loadCodeHostConnection(...)`, `repo = { hostRepoId, fullPath, defaultBranch }`.
    5. Upstream URL = `provider.remoteUrl(ref, repo)` + `/info/refs?service=...` or `/git-upload-pack`. Only allow `service` values of `git-upload-pack` or `git-receive-pack`; anything else gets 400.
    6. In this slice, both `service=git-receive-pack` on info/refs and POST `git-receive-pack` respond 403 text/plain `rakazo: pushing is not available yet\n`.
    7. Forward with the provider's fetch (the safe remote fetch from composition; expose it via a `fetch` passed in deps, defaulting to the one `createCodeHostProviders` used). Send:
       - method
       - `authorization: Basic base64(username:password)` from `provider.gitCredential(ref)`
       - copied headers: `content-type`, `accept`, `content-encoding`, `git-protocol`, `user-agent`
       - `body: c.req.raw.body`, `duplex: "half"`
       - `signal: c.req.raw.signal`
    8. Return `new Response(upstream.body, { status: upstream.status, headers })`. Copy only `content-type`, `cache-control`, `expires`, `pragma`, `content-encoding`.
    9. If upstream responds 401/403/404, return 403 text/plain `rakazo: the code host refused access to this repository\n`. Don't pass upstream bodies through on errors.
  - Log `getLogger().warn` with the binding id only (no tokens, no host URL query).
- **UPDATE** `apps/api/src/app.ts`:
  - add `["/git/*", "git proxy"]` to the `runAsSystem` prefix list (lines 892–899)
  - call `mountGitProxyRoutes(app, { prisma, secrets, codeHosts })` next to `mountWebhookHttpRoutes`
  - make sure CORS and `requestLogging` don't log the `authorization` header (check `requestLogging`)
- **GOTCHA**:
  - Hono's `c.req.raw.body` is a stream for `/git/*` because the body-limit middleware only buffers `/rpc/*` and `/api/auth/*`. Keep it that way.
  - Node `fetch` needs `duplex: "half"` for stream bodies.
  - Don't read the body before the grant is validated.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### CREATE `apps/api/src/git-proxy.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - **Unit (no git).** Use a `new Hono()` with `mountGitProxyRoutes` and a fake prisma:
    - no auth → 401 with `www-authenticate`
    - bogus grant → 403 whose text starts with `rakazo:`
    - ended run (`status: "completed"`) → 403
    - grant for binding A used on `/git/B.git` → 403
    - bad `:repo` → 404
    - `service=git-receive-pack` → 403 "pushing is not available yet"
    - no response body contains the emulator token or host
  - **Integration (`describe.skipIf(!hasGit())`).** Start the `CodeHostEmulator` for both flavors. Serve the Hono app on a real port with `@hono/node-server` `serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: 0 })`. Then:
    - `git clone http://rakazo:<grant>@127.0.0.1:<port>/git/<bindingId>.git` (or a credential helper) into a temp dir succeeds, and `git log` shows the seeded commit
    - a second `git fetch` succeeds
    - after the fake run's status becomes `completed`, `git fetch` fails and stderr contains `rakazo: this repository access has ended`
    - the emulator's request log shows the host token only on upstream requests, never in the client-facing responses
- **CREATE** `packages/adapters/src/git-proxy-grants.test.ts`:
  - issuing twice for the same run+binding keeps one row
  - the stored `tokenHash` ≠ token
  - `resolveGitProxyGrant` rejects inactive runs
- **UPDATE**: add a Postgres case to an existing run-finalization Postgres test (search `deleteRunSecretsInTransaction` in `*.postgres.test.ts`, or add `apps/api/src/git-proxy.postgres.test.ts`). A grant is deleted when the run is finalized or cancelled.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /git/<bindingId>.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack` with a valid grant streams the host's advertisement. `POST .../git-upload-pack` streams pack data both ways.
- [ ] No `Authorization` → 401 + `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="rakazo"`. Invalid, ended or mismatched grant → 403 text/plain starting `rakazo:`.
- [ ] Every request re-checks: grant hash, run active, binding still exists and matches, connection exists. Disconnecting cuts access on the next request.
- [ ] Pushes are refused with `rakazo: pushing is not available yet`.
- [ ] Grants are deleted on every run-ending path (via `deleteRunSecretsInTransaction`).
- [ ] The host token is never sent to the client or logged.
- [ ] Tests pass: `pnpm vitest run apps/api/src/git-proxy.test.ts packages/adapters/src/git-proxy-grants.test.ts`

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm check
pnpm vitest run apps/api/src/git-proxy.test.ts packages/adapters/src/git-proxy-grants.test.ts packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts
pnpm test:integration --spec=git-proxy
```
